{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# Only keep completed orders that are not QA
completed_no_qa = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != '999,999.99')]

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rate = completed_no_qa.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

# Print results
print(f'Conversion rates by segment (excluding QA and refunded):\n{conversion_rate}')
print(f'Best segment: {best_segment} with rate {best_rate:.4f}')"}
